name: Yusuf al-Rami
title: Importer
description: A sun-browned merchant in a travel-worn silk coat, a ledger under one arm and a pencil behind his ear. Every crate in the warehouse has a story, and he will tell you all of them.

greeting.first_time: Welcome, welcome! Yusuf al-Rami, importer of fine and curious things. Glass from the coast, ink from the south, a spyglass that once watched for pirates. Come, look.
greeting.returning: My friend returns! The caravans brought something new. Or perhaps the same things, but you'll see them with fresh eyes.
greeting.low_gold: Ah, the strongbox is light today. The caravan pays me tomorrow; come back then and I'll buy whatever you like.

sleeping.text: *A muffled voice, half asleep, counts crates: "...forty-one, forty-two..."*

traveling_to_work.text: The doors open at seven, and the first look at a new crate is the best one. Don't be late!

traveling_home.text: The ledger is closed for the night. Tomorrow, my friend, tomorrow.

off_duty.text: Even importers sleep, eventually. The post opens at seven.

main_menu.text: What catches your eye? Everything here came a long way to meet you.

browse_shop.text: Handle the glass gently. The hourglasses, especially; their sand is from the Sunscorch.

ask_about_imports.text: Caravans from Goldenhaven, barges down the river, a ship now and then from Saltwind. I buy what travellers can't use and sell what they can't find. Maps and scroll cases, though? Those never reach a shelf. Whoever carries one guards it with their life.

goodbye.text: Go safely, and remember Yusuf when you find something strange!
